sources.title: The Recommendation Architecture: Lessons from Large-Scale Electronic Systems Applied to Cognition
sources.institution: Murdoch University; author institutional ANU copy
sources.access: Institutional metadata https://researchportal.murdoch.edu.au/esploro/outputs/journalArticle/The-recommendation-architecture-lessons-from-large-scale/991005542110007891 ; selected text and manuscript p.31 image; Elsevier copyright

implemented: Separate clustering and competition systems; stable feature combinations and learned selection from consequence feedback.
learned: Author reports learning additional categories with limited disruption to prior recognition; figure 15 last 1000 presentations gives 94.7% versus 93.8% in two category introduction conditions.
designed: Clustering algorithms, consequences, input generator and competition machinery supplied.
limit: Not a zero-interference guarantee, independently replicated result, biological validation or organism-level evolution; manuscript figure condition labels retained without reconciling all counts.
ora: Test acquisition and retention separately; preservation of previous skills may incur memory costs.
rights: Factual metadata and original analysis only; no primary source redistribution.

sources.authors: J. William Murdock; Ashok K. Goel
sources.title: Meta-case-based reasoning: self-improvement through self-understanding
sources.institution: IBM Watson Research Center; Georgia Institute of Technology
sources.access: Author preprint; publisher metadata https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/09528130701472416 ; selected sections and preprint p.15 image; Taylor & Francis copyright

implemented: Reflective adaptation of task-method-knowledge models; reuse of known methods and Q-learning to resolve optional changes.
learned: Adapted existing disassembly model to assembly; Q-learning selects whether to use inserted steps; author reports cost scaling advantage over planning and situated learning on nested roof example.
designed: Explicit TMKL model of agent tasks/methods, primitive actions, goal conditions, relation-mapping algorithm, Q-learning and external planner.
limit: Opaque primitive procedure cannot be edited directly in illustrated example; model-based comparison uses more prior structural knowledge than primitive-only baselines. Not unrestricted self-rewriting or evolved cognition.
ora: Distinguish behavioral adaptation, editable internal model, and origin of modification mechanism.
rights: Factual metadata and original analysis only; no primary source redistribution.

sources.title: Unsurpervised Learning in Hybrid Cognitive Architectures
sources.institution: Carnegie Mellon; University of Colorado Boulder
sources.access: Public institutional proceedings copy; PDF indices 0 and 5 visually verified; AAAI copyright

implemented: Hybrid symbolic ACT-R and neural Leabra; cognitive retrieval and internally assigned labels feed perceptual rehearsal.
learned: Self-supervised object grouping in image experiment; figure 7 shows five of 15 categories at 100%, others substantially lower, including zero.
designed: Supplied perceptual architecture, retrieval rules, labeling/rehearsal process, data and evaluation criterion.
limit: Assigned labels are not independent semantic understanding; motor interaction proposed as further work; category performance heterogeneous, no organism-level evolution.
ora: Separate learned categories from supplied mechanisms and test transfer beyond stimulus sets.
